scripts.build: npm run build -w @writers-room/contracts && npm run build -w @writers-room/server && npm run build -w @writers-room/web
scripts.dev: node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @writers-room/server" "npm run dev -w @writers-room/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
